title: Submit a Platform
description: Run an AI porn site? Submit it for a free listing in the AI Porn Bible directory.

sections.body:
Listings are free. Email hello@aipornbible.com with your platform's name, URL, category, pricing, main features and a contact for verification. If you run an affiliate programme, include the details.

We check every submission before publishing it. A free listing doesn't guarantee a rating or a review, and paying for a sponsored placement doesn't change our editorial rating.

sections.heading: Listing requirements
sections.body: To be listed, a platform must prohibit content involving minors, must not offer undressing, nudifying or face-swapping of real people's photos, and must not clone real people's voices without permission. See our content policy for the full rules.
